newsitem.title: THAILAND: Nithipat to buy 30 pct of Thai bank.
newsitem.headline: Nithipat to buy 30 pct of Thai bank.

text.p: Nithipat Capital is set to buy about 30 percent of Bangkok Bank of Commerce from the Thai government's Fund for Rehabilitation and Development of Financial Institutions, a BBC spokesman said on Monday.
The spokesman told Reuters he expected Nithipat to make a decision within the next week or two, but said the firm had examined the bank's books and executives were now negotiating terms.
Bangkok Bank of Commerce has non-performing loans totalling approximately 70-80 billion baht (US$2.8-3.2 billion) and is the subject of a government rescue effort.
The government owns approximately 70 percent of the bank following its 25 billion-baht capital injection in late August.
Major Thai broker Securities One owns 24 percent of Nithipat Capital, and high-end property developer Land and House Plc owns 22 percent.
